title: Run commands in containers

checks.name: os.txt holds the os-release file of an Alpine container
hello.txt holds what echo printed in a container

hints: docker run --rm alpine:3 COMMAND runs a command in a fresh Alpine container and removes it afterwards.
Save the output with redirection on your side: docker run --rm alpine:3 cat /etc/os-release > os.txt
For the arithmetic, the shell must run inside the container: docker run --rm alpine:3 sh -c 'echo $((6 * 7))' > answer.txt
